subject: Compute every year once a place and year are chosen
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-07: when a place and a year have been chosen on the annual-map page, compute all the years. After the chosen year's map is created, the page queues the place's other available years (chosen year first, then newest first), one job at a time per visitor (the service runs one analysis at a time and queues at most 4 jobs), backs off on 429, stops when the place changes, never recomputes an existing map, and marks each year on the timeline as it completes. Page only (docs/js/lclu.js); the service and r10 are unchanged. Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration needs Tobias's reviewer=human line.
